items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: The Payne's, the Hand's family, they moved in there.

ctx.x: He had about five or six kids in there.

Then they left and I don't know who else came in after that. Because they had another house in the back. It was like a, a, You had to go through the alley to that place. The Simons lived back there. And several other families had moved in and out through the years. I don't know. Several people moved in. The Payne's, the Hand's family, they moved in there. And they left. And now the Little family, they moved in. And then Susie and Robert Little, they moved in. Then Susie left. Then Robert kept the house about…
It seems like y'all were the most stable family in the neighborhood.
